### 🎯 What does this PR do?

(what changed, the problem it solves, the scope — a few paragraphs, not a report)

### 🧪 How to test

(the steps a reviewer performs in the app and the result each one shows: what to open, click, play, or export, and what they should see or hear. Never list unit, E2E, typecheck, lint, or CI runs — reviewers do not re-run them and the checks list already shows them. Developer-facing/internal changes with no app surface exercise the tool itself — the command an operator runs and what it prints or refuses — rather than the specs that cover it; only a test-only change names the specs it changes.)

### 📌 Related issues & additional notes

(`Closes #N` — always link the issue this PR resolves; links to past PRs; any good-to-know info)
